status: Local prospective protocol for a theoretical extension; not external preregistration
relationship_to_original: Written after the original witness search and exact rejection of the K=4 floating-point witness. Original protocol/results remain unchanged. The coverage embedding was derived analytically before this new simulation.
question: Does the explicit K=3 two-temperature softmax embedding reproduce the exact minimum-of-independent-order-statistics coverage law?
construction: Independent U1,U2 uniform[0,1]; s=1+delta*U1, v=5/8+delta*U2, w_minus/plus=(s-/+sqrt(2v-s^2))/2; logits=[0,log(w_minus),log(w_plus)]; true label=0.
selector: Select the inverse temperature with the smallest baseline-normalized empirical conformal quantile. This is an adversarial calibration-data-only selector, NOT negative-log-likelihood tuning.
controls: same-total-data split: first 50 observations tune, remaining 49 calibrate
ordinary NLL tuning restricted to the same grid {1,2}; chooses 2 because all predictions are correct

diagnostics.interpretation: Direct Beta sampling of the analytically derived law; not physical logits simulations for M>2

criteria: Maximum absolute discrepancy between recovered latent cutoffs and raw order statistics below 1e-10
Every input maps to positive distinct roots below one, by both analytic interval bounds and checks
Main mean coverage is within five Monte Carlo standard errors of quadrature expectation
Independent/fixed/split/NLL controls within five Monte Carlo standard errors of their exact expectations
Report all failures and do not rerun seeds to obtain success
scope: Mathematical construction validation; no real-data efficacy, no NLL failure claim, no claim that ordinary full-conformal methods cannot achieve validity. Empty LAC sets are permitted.
